The Free Traders can't sit idly when troubles plague the world!

Nihaz's spies are everywhere – how does one decide who can be trusted and who should be feared?

So we came up with this idea: 30 days and 30 tasks for each day – no spy can handle that! The deeds are useful, and rewards are valuable. Everyone is happy!

But we know heroes can have one of those days, so don't worry: you can skip a few quests that turn out to be too difficult. You can still earn the best reward.

It's easy: I'll be here every day, and each day you can get a special task for me. If you complete it on the same day, you'll get a reward that you can exchange later. And if you don't, you get nothing.

And you do that 30 days in a row, each day with it own task!
You can see the prizes right here – just trade with me! But the best prizes are reserved for the most persistent ones!

You're too late, the Marathon is over!

Buy your prizes, and if you couldn't participate – don't despair and wait for the next race!

Hey, you! Yes, you! Come here! Are you looking for batteries for your armor? Or maybe you need memory modules?
Tell me, whom did you meet in the Thicket of the Primals? What did our ancestors teach you?

Belly symbolizes your inner power. The bear seems to be fat and clumsy, but it's a deceptive imprression. He is smart, strrong, and guileful, but doesn't show it off. He lives in harmony with nature and obeys the Forest Law, which he told you about. He doesn't hunt for fun like we do; he loves nature and only uses its gifts when he can give something in rreturn.

It's a good sign that you met him, eysh!

Oh, I haven't met Mirrah, but other trrainers told me about her grace and dexterity. She is strrong and merciless, and she doesn't accept compromise.

The world is crruel, eysh! But we are hunters, and we are in charrge of our lives. The one who resigns to their fate and accepts the inevitable, becomes prey, eysh!

Boa, the grreat serpent, the Two-Tongued... He is close to spellcasters, trappers, and trrainers like me. His words are wisdom, eysh! Each trainer has met him in the Thicket of the Primals and learned about the essence of things. This knowledge has led us to understanding the world and ourselves.

It's strrange that you've met spirits that are so different from each other. I think the path of your life will be very winding...

Scar and Baccy... They are the vice! Anger, prride, lie, and hypocrisy. I told you about death that would be standing by your side. You can't win unless you fight your vice! If you give in to the vice, you will die, if you fight for the virtue, you will win! I'm sure you will choose the latter!

Was there anything else I should know about?

Unbelievable... The Enlightened! Ay-hya! You are the Enlightened, the Primals are never wrong!

The gift of Light is the biggest gift that the Primals can give to a young Priden. We have gifted us with fire, the crrafts, the arts of hunting and fighting. But the gift of Light is something very special, eysh! The ones whose tya shines brighter than the stars cannot die of a wound or a sickness. Only old age or a complete destruction of the body can prevent your resurrection.

Anyway, I'm a mere Trainer, and I can't tell you much about the gift of Light. My tya will dissolve in Yao Realm. When the time comes, my tyarra will melt, and a new tyalla will be born through my descendants.

Go to Khuus-Margen, our expert. He is Enlightened, too, so he can tell you about the gift of Light and teach you how to master its power.

You can find him at the blacksmith's shop in the Khuus Camp. There are many outlanders there, who value our hunter's trophies and weapons, so the Khuus Branch, who trrade with them, usually settle close the Port to keep the tailless away from the Residence.
Errr... Are you going to eat me? Hic!

Hey, I'm not lost! I'd never get... Hic! Who's drunk? Me?! No way! I'm just strolling about, smelling the flowers, writing poems...

You see, I just didn't want to go back on my own... I mean, without a company. You are a good company! Please, come with me, I'm scared...
Step back! We have some ideological disagreements here! Either this Kanian drunkard will accept the truth, or I will break his jaw!

This blatant mule won't accept the sanctity of Nezeb and Skrakan!

Holy Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan were the ones who gave life to the world. Yes, Tensess was the first one to give the Light to people, but it doesn't lessen the merits of great Nezeb and wise Skrakan, who brought the Light to all mortals and gave up their lives in battle with Demons!

The Trinity Church worships them equally, and those retrogrades of the Holy Church are merely renegades and charlatans!
Calm down?! I am as calm as a dead goblin! I will calmly tell that unshaved mug what our postulates are all about!

Yes, right... That would be really foolish if I was sent back to Nezebgrad because of a fight.

Alright, tell that bearded mug that I overreacted. We will discuss it later... Away from prying eyes!
What do you want? You better help me punch that brat in the face! He dares to defile the pictures of Holy Tensess, huh!

This mug thinks that their Nezeb and Skrakan are just as sacred as Tensess himself! What a nonsense!

Nezeb and Skrakan were heroes who gave their lives to fight Demons and saved us all, but the Light was only given by Tensess, and everyone else must worship him. This is the teaching of our church - Tensess brought the Light to people in the dark years to save them from dying and hurting, and to give them strength to fight Demons. And so we did!

That Xadaganian was the first one to pick on me, hey! He decries my church and offends me!

I'm not gonna kill him, just beat him up a little! If he wants to settle this, then he owes me an apology!
Alright, alright! I know that we are guests here, and we ain't supposed to fight. If he calms down, I will stand back.
You are one lucky kylys. Defeating Old Ekhe is a grreat deed!

Are you making fun of me, kuttas? Go on, laugh! Sooner or later I will receive my second name, and it will be either the Slaughterous or the Invincible, eysh!

Oh, who am I fooling?.. I am one unlucky kylys. It takes a lot of pain and effort from me to do things that come so easily to the Enlightened ones like you! It's not fair!

I'm sorry I lost my temper. I thought you would chicken out and rrefuse to enter the Circle. We were both punished for my stupidity.
Thank you, kylys. I hope I will be accepted to the same Branch as you!
Aho, kinsman! You want to watch the cinema, too? They say the spectacle is rather imprresive, eysh!
Is it starting already? Ay-hya! I'm on my way!
Aho, kinsman. I'm Aata. What is your name? Do you have the second name yet? I can't wait to get rid of my childish name!

You want to make a cape of white fur, zoor? But there are no white-furred animals around here. I know these cliffs better than anyone!

But I know someone who has fur like that. The creatures from the League! I heard Dool the Cuckoo calling them the Gibberlings. I bet these are their hairs, eysh!

The furry fellows always walk in threes. I think they are trrading something with Dool the Cuckoo... Dool is one sly hunhurr! Ask him, what is it they trrade with the Gibberlings? I want to trade, too!
Are you talking about the rats? Nobody's furry here apart from us and the rats.

How come?! Ay-hya! Is it because of me? I didn't mean to!

Those furry creatures - they are called the Gibberlings - asked me to put out the torch lights in the camp. They swore that that was just a joke, eysh! And since I was assigned to light the torches, I got my benefit from that... Those furry deceivers!

They live in another camp, with other tailless outlanders from the League. They wanted me to watch their show instead of the cinema. But I didn't go, I had a lot of things to do.

Please, don't tell anyone, zoor? If the tailless find this out, they won't let me see the cinema!
How did you like the cinema? Do you feel inspired and proud for the Empire? No? Huh. You must be too uncivilized for it. Sorry, no offence meant!

I've found your flask. Propagandina has confiscated it due to our antialcoholism program.

Confiscating flasks is not our method. We pursue cultural education!

Return the missing flask to the Gibberlings and tell them about the Imperial art! Explain to them that cinema is the future!
Aho, kinsman! Why are you disturbing me?

The blood on your hands is the blood of a tya-ah, a Priden of the trribe cursed by the spirits and bereft of tyarra!

When the Golases united Priden trribes, some of them refused to follow. When the leaders and the tyrants fell under our onslaught, their henchmen were scattered in the mountains. They kept on attacking us from time to time. And then the Great Disaster came. The world was split apart, eysh! That was a hard time; many has lost their minds. We fought for each piece of brread and each sip of fresh water... The only reason why we survived was that we stayed united! The wisdom of our ancestors and the Golases' will led us through those dark times. And the rest of Pridens... They lost their tyarra, they became tya-ah. They look just like us, but their tya is crippled. Tyalla without tyarra is like a blade without a handle!

When the world was young, grreat heroes were often born among Pridens, eysh! They became leaders, and the others were ready to kill and die on their orrders. They were strong and prroud, and didn't want to share their power with anyone. So our people were divided...

Many moons had passed since. The heroes quarreled and resigned, fought and died, and the ones who trrusted them died by their side. But still there were wise men among the leaders, who loved their people more than wealth and power. They united and confrronted those drunk with blood. They called themselves the Golases of the Pack. Those heroes showed Pridens that strength is in unity!

They trrusted and never betrayed each other. When they overthrew the last leader, they knew that they can't lead all Pridens together. Then young heroes accomplished their grreatest feat - they swore to serve the ones that believed in them forever, and they swore on their own blood, eysh! They sacrificed themselves! But the bravehearts didn't die - their oath kept them in this world. They became the trrue Golases - invisible, unfleshly, but omniscient and infinitely wise.

And so began the Branches. Each Branch lives separately and follows its Golas. He doesn't rule but directs it, doesn't order but suggests, doesn't judge but reconciles... It was solely the wisdom of the Golases that has led us through all the hardships to unity and strength, eysh!
We need to prrotect our lands from hunhurrs. Are you with me, kylys?
Get out of the way! I need to report on the attack!

Tya-ah have attacked the Residence! They chase our women and rob our houses! The filthy bastards are everywhere! They came down the mountains and passed the stones! The Guardians didn't stop them!

Pass my message to Tyym-Khos! I am going back. I need to warn the camps!
Are we under attack? We will fight back! The Golases may be silent, but their power is with us!
Are you with us, Enlightened? I hope the Primals have chosen you for a reason!
Huh, that's smart! You want to fool the dumbos, right? That ain't that hard to do. But you better not give yourself away, huh!
Huh! There must be some clothes my bag. Yep, this will do.
Are you off your chumps, girlfriend? You're too small even for a female orc, huh! You better ask the bone-legged, Tabhut. You are both skinny!
Who are you? You're from Uuk's pack? Tell him he's an ass!
First you will fight with our warriors. I will watch. I am smart, I will learn.
You want to fight with me? I will beat you!
You fight fast. I didn't get it. Will you show again?
I think yes. Fight me! I will defeat you!
Oh, hello! I was sent here to speak on behalf of the League. Before the Imperial ambassador stuffs your head with their dumb propaganda. Besides, your commander is so... manly.

I know who you are talking about. His name was Akyn or Akyl, right? He was trying to hit on me back in the Port with his raunchy jokes.

He offered to run our ship to Howlem. There is no way we could have reached it on our own, with all the storms and anomalies! While we were travelling, I came to the deck to take a look at your beautiful allod, and then I saw several Astral boats undocking from the ship ahead and heading to a small shard near your allod. I didn't pay much attention to that, but now it's clear to me that Akyl has sent his accomplices there!

Magical stone? Let me have a look... Oh! Don't you know what it is? It's a June Adventurer's Stone!

This stone is used to create a small Portal and travel to a certain stationary Portal from anywhere in the world! Also, it can arouse magic of ancient June Portals. Although I don't know the required spells. I'm just an ambassador, not a Great Mage. We could use some help from one right now!

We have the key, and we have the lock. They are connected, but you can't turn the key if you put it in upside down, eysh!

Listen and do what I say, kylys. I believe we can make it. The Primals are favoring us!
Get ready, kylys. Listen to the harmony of the world and open the lock!

It's a great honor to speak to you, bayazy. When cubs like you are born, it brings hope to our hearts! A hope that once Pridens will live, and not just survive. Do you understand what it means, zoor? Sooner or later the Golases will be gone. They will dissolve in the stream of time, disappear among the threads of the past and the future, like Gaal is already disappearing.

Find your own way, kylys. You have deserved the right.

Aho, kylys. It may be hard for you to believe, but I wish I could fight next to you! The Golases are not the best advisors, you know. And those arrogant hunhurrs should be put where they belong, eysh!

The Heart of the Pack works perfectly well. It will be the hunt of the century, you'll see!

Aho! The spirits' world is waiting for you, kylys! Don't be afraid of it. Your world, my world, the spirits' world, and the world of the outlanders - they all look different at first sight. But in fact they are all one. They are all parts of a whole, eysh! If you fear one little world, you fear the whole world, too. And fear is alien to a true Priden. Remember that.

Don't fear anything, child. The spirit' world will tolerate no weakness. I will be your guide, but remember - when the time comes for the final battle, I won't be able to help you. Your victory or your defeat will belong to you solely.

The world of spirits is just as dangerous as yours, child. You've had to learn the rules of your world to survive, hadn't you, zoor? Now you must learn the rules of the spirits' world, too. First of all, remember - your will sculptures the world like pottery clay. As long as you know what you want, the dangers will pass you by.

Think of your enemies and concentrate on that thought. They are your purpose and your prey. All you need is to obtain their power to summon the patron spirits, and use their help to eliminate the threat that is hanging over Pridens.

Remember about that. Let your instincts do the rest, eysh!

Wherever your destiny leads you, death will always follow you. You are destined to eternal battle. A lingering, never-ending war. You will fight for someone else's ideas. You will risk your head for those whose life is not worth a dime. You will have to wrest your soul from powerful enemies with your claws and teeth.

In the end, you deeds will determine fates. Not only fates of Pridens, but of all creatures in this world. So is your lifeline, child. Accept it.

The Holy Land is a truly wondrous allod. This ancient land was once home to the June, and after their demise it became home to the Zem. It is also where Tep himself built a colossal pyramid ages ago.

After the final battle of the Great Astral Campaign, this pyramid became home to the soul of Tensess, the Great Kanian Mage. After that the pyramid became known as Tensess Temple, and it is from there that all of the world's Holy magic originates.

The Empire seeks to capture the Temple and take control of the world's Holy magic. That would drain the power from all of the League's priests and paladins. Even worse, it would deprive us of the ability to be reborn after death.

For years now we've been warring with the Empire in the Holy Land. And though our cause is just, victory is a long ways off.
Greetings, comrade! I've heard that you wish swear allegiance to the great Empire. Good for you! I hope your people will see, too, that the future belongs to the Empire, and join our ranks!

Welcome aboard! This ship's destination is Novograd!

By the way, have you ever been to Novograd? It is the best place in the world. You will love it!

I'm glad that the Imperial ambassadors didn't have time to stuff your head with their propaganda. Their promises are as empty as a bottomless bottle! The League will show you the way of the real adventures!

What a surprise... The Golases often refuse to accept Pridens to the Branches because of their stupidity, weakness, or vice. Some of our kinsmen refuse to accept the will of the Golases and leave Howlem voluntarily. But the Golases have never sent anyone to find their destiny in the big world, eysh!

If the Golases think that the path of your life leads you to the Holy Land, you will need some powerful allies. Even the Enlightened can't survive on their own in the big world, eysh!

The Empire or the League? It's up to you to decide. Both have their merits and flaws. Some favor freedom and dignity of the League, some loyalty and cohesion of the Empire.

Remember - once you have chosen one side, you will become enemies with the other one forever. The war between the League and the Empire has been going on for many centuries, and there will be no end to it. When you join a side, you will find your loyal friends... and your deadly enemies!
Remember: your faith is the key to victory!
Remember: your faith is the key to victory!

Our church worships three deceased Great Mages - Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan. As I already told you, Tensess gave the Empire and the League citizens the ability to resurrect. Later, when Nezeb and Skrakan - the Great Mages of the Empire and the League, respectively - died while protecting this world from demons, our church sanctified them, and thus transformed into the Trinity Church. We believe that the three Mages watch after us even after their death.

Unfortunately, some do not share our views.

The League Holy Church is the congregation of the most blatant conventionalists in Sarnaut. They refuse to sanctify Nezeb because he belonged to the Empire, and so they don't recognize Skrakan's sacrifice, just because he died together with Nezeb! They still worship Tensess alone, and the Gift that he gave us. Everything else is considered heresy!

Avengers are the warriors of Light, who serve the Trinity Church. They are mostly Xadaganian. Orcs who devote their life to the Church are called Reavers. They compensate their poor diplomacy skills with excellence in battle craft. Most orcs just need a good fight and a reason for it. Unfortunately, we can give them both in plenty.

Inquisitors and Heretics form the core of our Church. They help us keep our faith strong in these dark times. Thanks to them, we always remember that even the most impenetrable darkness can give birth to the Light!

Also, they know how to use the Holy magic to fight against demons. The Trinity Church can both stand up for itself, and also protect the Empire from its hideous enemy.
Hello, child. What brings you here?

A Great Mage called Tensess bestowed his last blessing upon the world when his was dying. Our Church worships his feat as the greatest miracle of the Light, and spreads the word of it to all corners of the world. The Light gives us strength in the darkest times, and our faith in Tensess deprives us of fear in battle!

Please, child, don't mention the Empire's godawful heresy. Nezeb and Skrakan have nothing to do with the Gift of Tensess. I admit that their sacrifice meant a lot for the people of Sarnaut, and they should be admired. But don't put their names next to Tensess!

The Trinity Church gets its way with cunning and lies. I am really sorry for its followers. They are merely chain dogs of the Empire leaders, and not faithful servants of the Light. All that beautiful lie about the three saints is just a sad attempt to make themselves look good. They want to show off that they recognize everyone's merits.

Crusaders and Templars are fearless protectors of the Holy Church. They protect the League faithfully and loyally. They scorch heresy and darkness with their file hard swords and the holy word, and nothing can stand against their righteous anger!

You can fight side by side with them, if you want to join us. We will be happy to accept a Priden whose heart shines so brightly.

Clerics and Priests spread the word of the Light to all the corners of the world. Their greatest weapon against heresy and darkness is the Holy magic, which destroys the enemies of our Church with cleansing fire.

You can fight side by side with them, if you want to join us. We will be happy to accept a Priden whose heart shines so brightly.
Oh, hello! I hope you don't need my service?
Ah, how sad! I just now began to feel at home in this inhospitable place...
Hi. Sit down on the bunk and tell me where it hurts.
We're moving? That's reasonable. Straight into a crowd of walking dead? Not so reasonable.
Greetings! I'd bid you good day, but that's an unaffordable luxury under the circumstances.
Not bad. We need to seize the opportunity and study what is left of the Great Mage's dwelling.
Somebody, help me! Thank the Light, you found me before Tep's servants did! Please help me return to the refuge. I hope my brothers are alive...
We're now out of the course of time. Here, we have an eternity for all kinds of talk.

I was a mage and lived a long time ago, at a time immemorial you might say. False modesty aside, I was a pretty good mage. A great one, to be more precise. These ruins around us are all that remains of my tower. The reason for its downfall was the experiment I held with my colleagues - a complex and incredibly ambitious one that had promised unparalleled power, although it yielded sad results, as you see.
I must add the Divine Gift was at that time non-existent. The dead - imagine that - would not rise but remain dead. To provide for contingencies, I prepared a special spell - a failsafe, if you will. In case of a failure, that spell was to slow down the course of time to allow timely evacuation of the experimenters. Alas, I had underestimated the power of the force we were about to unleash. The energy we released amplified the effect of my spell by an order of magnitude. Time didn't just slow down, it froze altogether. The tower, my disciples and I were trapped within a single instant. It was only thanks to the intervention of a necromancer familiar to you that the time magic could be broken and my freedom of action partially restored.
A glow is rising from the core of the crystal... The ruins are coming back to life!
Save me! Argh... Is it over? Oh, what took you so long? I already thought no one was going to save me...

I guess I'm even worse as a liar than I am as a fighter. Wait, wait, let me finish! This time, I'll tell you the truth. Then, it's up to Sonin and you to decide if I may live or should be pushed into the Astral.
It's true, I never was a captive of Tep's. I used to be a cultist. I believed in eternal life and offered my services to Tep voluntarily. I worked on the Irdrich base since its foundation and I was one of the leading developers of the illusory web.
You can throw me into the Astral, I deserve that. Tensess is unlikely to forgive me and resurrect me again. I can only say one thing to justify myself: I'm not here because Tep ordered me. I saw what he was doing and what he was after. I repented and vowed to prevent him from ascending his throne, only I had nowhere to run. Once I knew about the Resistance on Irdrich, I fled to you right away.
Tep knows about your existence, but he's no more scared of you than he is of rats. He is arrogant, and that will ruin him. If you allow me to join the Resistance, I'll show you some weaknesses in his defenses. Together, we'll destroy the trap of illusion and stop that monster!

Tep... Till this day, I can't help but marvel at the power hidden in his madness. Who'd ever thought that someone who died once would almost succeed in pulling the whole world into nothingness with him?
I am scared by how easily Tep would extinguish his enemies. By how easily he created an entire world, albeit an illusory one. If that's not divine power, then it's very, very close. And I have an idea what the secret of his incredible power is. The Seals!
I know Tep had experimented with a small fragment of one of the Seals and derived the power to create his Plague from it. It is one of the manifestations of the Sources - the manifestation of Death. But the Pyramid... Illusions, energy, matter, creating new life and influencing the mind. A full set of powers accessible to the Great Mages, reinforced by extremely sophisticated spells. No, I don't believe Tep could achieve all that by himself. After all, until recently he was but a body howling in pain, suspended between life and death. I'm sure someone helped Tep! Someone who knows everything about our Great Experiment.

I think you already guessed the bitter truth, so I'm only scattering your last doubts. The Great Experiment and the Cataclysm are one and the same!
Blinded by our pride, we searched for ways to grow our power and we found the Sources. We had no idea then what the Seals were and why they were important. Every one of us the Great Mages wanted only one thing - power, free power!
 We tried to subdue the power of the Seals. When our first attempt failed, we continued to attack the Source Seal again and again with the most powerful spells till it cracked and gushed its power into the world. Power against power, understand? The Seals could not bear it, the world's shell cracked and the Astral put an end to the Sarnaut as I knew it. You know the rest - the world in ruins, the legend of the Patrons, the Great Mages being the last stronghold of order in a realm of chaos... But I see that you don't seem to believe my words.
You won the battle but not the war!

Tep... Till this day, I can't help but marvel at the power hidden in his madness. Who'd ever thought that someone who died once would almost succeed in pulling the whole world into nothingness with him?
I am scared by how easily Tep would extinguish his enemies. By how easily he created an entire world, albeit an illusory one. If that's not divine power, then it's very, very close. And I have an idea what the secret of his incredible power is. The Seals!

But the Pyramid... Illusions, energy, matter, creating new life and influencing the mind. A full set of powers accessible to the Great Mages, reinforced by extremely sophisticated spells. No, I don't believe Tep could achieve all that by himself. After all, until recently he was but a body howling in pain, suspended between life and death. I'm sure someone helped Tep! Someone who knows everything about our Great Experiment.

 We tried to subdue the power of the Seals. It doesn't matter if you know about me. What matters is what I know about you!
Where are we? What's going on?
So, my guess has been right. The beautiful green Irdrich was merely a dream indeed... But what is awaiting us in reality?

An unexpected turn, eh? Hey, wake up at last! Stop twisting your head! Yes, it's me, Klavdia. You'll ask questions later - can't you see what's going on?
That's Irdrich, the real Irdrich. Consider the aviak story something you dreamed of. Enough, no more questions if you still want to live! There's an astral sloop and some fellow sufferers around the corner. Get through to them and hold back the charging mechanoids until the engine starts. We'll talk when we get to safety. Good luck!

Well... I can understand it, but I'm not happy about it. Still, I must say something.

The local Orcs have a large part to play in what's about to happen on Suslanger. Don't ask me how I know that.

I'm asking you not to kill any of them. Prove that heroes can save lives, not just end them.

And that's about it.

I was hoping you'd say that. Listen.

The local Orcs have a large part to play in what's about to happen on Suslanger. Don't ask me how I know that.

I'm asking you not to kill any of them. Prove that heroes can save lives, not just end them.

And that's about it.

Yes. To make sure we mean something to each other after everything that happened.

I understand that our meeting was a strange one, but I still hope you have more reasons to trust me than to doubt me. Trust is very important to me...

Before I tell you my last request for today, I want to hear you say it again. Do you trust me or not?
Of course! She presented you as someone who can solve our numerous problems. I can't have you hear about these problems from third parties.

As you already know, an Incident took place on our allod. It disrupted communications with other allods... An astral storm of unknown strength and origin, and it doesn't look like it's going to abate.

The Gates are the cause, of course... It's not the first time it has happened, alas... but this project is too important to abandon.

We suspect it might be sabotage. Gates-3 were ready for a test launch, they were accumulating energy for a test run... And suddenly this happens!

You need to find out what exactly happened and caused the Incident.

Alas, we know very little at the moment. The Incident occurred in the evening when most of the scientists were finishing their work. We have witnesses, but there are few of them.

They have all been evacuated from the site where the project was constructed... And they are here in the city.

Alas, this event is not the only problem on our allod. But others can wait. Now we need to deal with our teleportation problems, so you don't get trapped again.

Eladia and I gave it a thought, and I think we found something!

There's a way to configure the portals so that the teleports on Suslanger will be focused on you - meaning, it won't be you teleporting to the teleportation device, but the device itself will be teleporting you to it. Sound complicated, doesn't it?

Yes, quite. And what's most important: this method consumes a lot of energy - more than the mana conduit in Nezebgrad consumes in a month! Fortunately, we have energy - we stored it for the Gates-3. We'll have to spend it all on you... So please find out everything quickly.

At least we don't need to let anyone off the allod before we solve all our problems and get Yasker's permission!
Excellent. Now go speak with Eladia and get down to work!
Hero of Sarnaut, I believe? It's nice to meet you!

Oh, it was terrifying! An explosion, screams, calls for help. Fortunately, we managed to get away before everything was covered with that... Ambrosia. My thoughts on what happened?

The eruption happened at the site, but we had nothing to do with it... It was something else...

Hmm, I'm the head of the elven engineers who arrived here at Aidenus and Catherina's request. The Gates-3 project is the child of both the League and the Empire, their attempt at reaching other worlds and spaces... The Great Ball is over, the Galleon Castle is complete - that's why we agreed to work here... Alas, not all differences can be overcome! Instead of working, we are forced to fill in hundreds of forms and questionnaires from the Xadaganian bureaucrats.

The incident? I'm sure it was sabotage...

I haven't told anyone about this, but before we ran... I mean, evacuated from the site, I noticed that an important part was missing... The Chronophone! What is a Chronophone? Well, the thing that makes traveling through time and space possible! It influences the strings that comprise reality!

The Chronophone was stolen, I'm certain of it. Perhaps that's what caused the eruption... But it's possible the eruption happened before it was stolen...

There were only our four groups at the site. So it must be one of them. Who could it be? My people are out. Zem? Unlikely. I've known Negus Kheket for a while, none of them need it. The elves? It's possible, but I'm not sure what their motives would be. It's unlike them to sabotage their own work... And Herbert was so enthusiastic. There's one possibility: this Zarida with Catherina backing her. Catherina also wants to build a portal to another world, possibly using her Eclipse. That's why the Chronophone was stolen

It's strange that you've never heard of me... I've worked on one of the Gates projects before. Without false modesty, I admit that the creator of the Gates-2 and Gates-3 largely used my work as a basis.

The last few years weren't kind to me. The launch of the Gates-2 was even worse... To begin with, we teleported the Great Mage Zayan from the past, which almost caused our entire timeline to collapse! And then... we decided to prevent Tep's Plague... But made a mistake in calculations and teleported it here. So Gates-2 are currently in quarantine, and I've been answering very awkward questions at the Committee for years.

And only when the construction of Gates-3 was underway, I was allowed to come here, to Suslanger... And now we have problems again!

I'm fairly certain it's the Zem. Every other one is a Tep Cultist! Even though Tep is dead, his minions are still alive and kicking. The Empire has always had issues with the Arisen - they keep running into maniacs and cultists.

What happened in Laboratory-9? In the White One-17? And in the Area 51? And of course, the very first Gates and Negus Jeeg who went insane! So I believe one of Negus Kheket engineers had a hand in this.

Greetings.

It is not possible to establish the causes without analyzing the readings of the equipment during the incident. Extrapolation suggests that sabotage took place. Or a criminal disregard for safety regulations.

Interviewing my staff allowed me to reconstruct a rough sequence of the events. Everything happened the day before the test launch of the Gates. Sufficient energy was accumulated, preparations were underway for the first launch...

However, the Gates were opened before we were ready. With high probability: the Ambrosia is the result of the release of energy from the other side.

I have no proof, but I suspect the elves are to blame. They have no concept of discipline, focused as they are on their fantasies.

I personally had to veto a dozen ideas that Herbert's group showered us with. They want to improve this, upgrade that. Even though the project was approved in advance, and we had to follow the plan!

It's possible one of their "improvers" messed something up.

Negus Kheket, the Head Scientist of the Arisen. In the absence of the chairman of the Scientific Councils of Nefer Ur, I'm handling the affairs of the Arisen in the capital of the Empire. Currently serving as the leader of the Arisen research group on the Gates-3 project.

I'm not sure how reasonable it was to entrust the creation of the Gates to various groups that had not previously worked together, but the leaders of the Empire insisted on it.
Greetings on behalf of all Zem people!
Hello! How can I help you?

How could I be there? And what makes you think so? Look how many pioneers are in the city! And you think it was me of all people?

You say a Chronophone went missing? But the Gates can still be repaired? Phew, I was afraid they were completely broken... I wonder what could cause irreparable damage?

Don't look at me like that. Theoretically speaking, I mean. You know, I want to help you. I think... the pirates did it. Yes, astral pirates got here. They needed the Chronophone, and they can disguise themselves as any pioneer. And I'm just an exobiologist. Let's try and figure out who it could be.

Alice, you say? She's the mysterious guest from the past?

Well... You know, I see "Daddy's" hand in this, but I'm not sure what he's playing at. Where's the demonic invasion? Who is this girl that's not even trying to hide? None of this makes sense.

At any rate, she slowed us down. No, she didn't stop us, just slowed our progress. This Chronophone she stole is a very complex device. It took us months to build it. I'm afraid we don't have that much time now. But what do we do? Catch the girl and shake her until she gives up everything she knows?

She could have hidden the device. And if she's one of Nihaz's creatures, you could cut her up and she still wouldn't say a thing. Damnation! What do we do?

Fine, fine. You wanted to wriggle into her favor? Let's play this game. Try asking her delicately - though I know it's not your forte - where the device could be. Nihaz loves games, so we'll play along. We've outplayed him before, right?
What's so strange? I changed into my uniform. I'm a pioneer. Can't just walk around the city in my exobiologist suit.
Greetings. How is your research going?

Good question!

I think you'll find this interesting. The Ambrosia is materialized energy, something like mana which is materialized astral energy. But unlike mana, the Ambrosia is more concentrated. Which means, you if you use it as fuel for ships or mana stations, the energy output will be a hundred times greater! Imagine the potential!

It also has a strong vitalizing effect. Heals wounds, reduces fatigue. However, in large amounts it changes creatures... But if we determine a correct dose...

And another fact. There's a similarity between the Ambrosia and the sap of the Ancient Trees.

Do you believe me or not?
That's too bad! But I think my research will prove that I'm right. I just need to carry out more research. I guess I'll have to go back to the desert.
Wonderful! I knew you'd understand! Alright, now I need to prove my case to everyone else. I need to carry out more research. I guess I'll have to go back to the desert.
You can't rely on miracles these days, you have to be the captain of your destiny!
Hello, hello. Are you here to try your luck at treasure-hunting during the storm?
I can offer you a great camel for {cost}. It's good-tempered and can carry as much as two horses!
That's not nice... I guess you don't need a camel that much, then. I'm not one to insist...
Here are the papers. I'll get it ready - you'll be able to collect the camel very soon.

No, that's not enough. That won't even get you a mule, let alone a camel. But alright, I'm willing to give you a discount.

I'll sell it to you for {costM}.
A camel costs more in the desert, especially when the closest oasis is 3 days away, and you're out of water.
This camel will turn your life around! Here are the papers. I'll get it ready - you'll be able to collect the camel very soon.
That will put me out of business, but you're right. Camels haven't been in great demand recently. Alright, I'll lower the price to {costM}.
Then you can trek across the desert on foot!
Just remember: you have to be gentle with camels. They are proud animals. Here are the papers. I'll get it ready - you'll be able to collect the camel very soon.
Good afternoon! Going on a journey to the desert? My camels are the best in the area!
That's robbery! I'm not selling you anything!
These are high quality tools, you won't regret it!
The box might be old. But it's like new, it was barely used. Alright, I'll sell it to you for {costM}.
That's not junk! They are all rarities... Ah, why do I bother!
They are good tools, don't worry!
They are in great condition, like new. Ah, fine. {costM}, then. But not a coin less!
You won't find them cheaper anywhere. Well, it's your choice...
That's more like it. Tell everyone about my shop. Bring your relatives. I have everything!
That's my kind of customer! I'll sell you ten bottles for {cost}. It's the desert after all, and water is valuable here!
Hah, for that price you can get your water from the nearest river.

It's true. But the water here was never priced at that. Still, as the first customer of the day, you get a discount.

I'll sell it to you for {costM}.
Well, then there's no water for you!
The same pack? Another ten bottles? Hmm... If you buy ten more bottles later... Then fine, I'll lower the price to {costM}.
Good luck finding someone who will sell you this much water for less.
Great! Don't forget to buy another pack later!
Greetings, greetings! Are you going on a trip or just restocking? It's the best water in the city, I'll even give you a discount.

You have made this journey and you don't even know where you are going? I should have kept you from entering the Court of Miracles, but I failed.

Eruption of the Ambrosia? You are talking about the divine power that awakened the jinns? We slept for centuries, for our strength began to wane after the world was split... Only a few continued to stay awake and serve the man the Great Nezeb, our master and enslaver, handed us over to.

But this eruption awakened us! We became guardians of the treasures again... But not Nezeb's this time. There's darkness threatening this world... I'll tell you what you want to know, even though I'm bound by a vow of servitude.

This Ambrosia is a divine power. It's more ancient than our world. It came to us with the girl that came here from another time. Her path took her through the city and to the desert... that's where she ran into the Orcs.

Now farewell. I serve the Gray Prince now, so don't stand in his way.
I didn't think you could defeat me...

You're asking me... No one knows! Well, they are the pioneers - they are quite inventive. We need to find out who stole the part, and it won't be easy to wriggle into everyone's favor. But I'm working on it!

I doubt it. You're not even a pioneer! Who would let you stick your nose into other people's business? The pioneers have different heroes anyway...

Better deal with other problems for now, and leave that to me. And tell that to Eladia, too.
Oops, where am I... I was just training... It's you again, my friend! I'm glad to see you...

What does it matter now? What, you think it's something new for me? We went through so much together, I wouldn't even be surprised if you sent me to another planet! A desert is nothing...

Yes, and I know many things...

There'll be time for that. Yes, and now I'm so powerful that I'll be the first to figure it out! He's not just a Great Mage, he's also Lorzub reborn...? Oh, if only my mother knew!

And, it looks like not everyone is happy that you and I are chatting. That Orc girl looks at you like... she wants to talk. You and that redhead should go...

Your broad is organizing everything. As far as I understand, she's... Pretty cool, what else can you say.

All we need to do is create the right atmosphere while the others are getting ready. Let's sit down?
Skulnar has a lot on his plate these days... I hope you guys can handle it.

Oh, my young friend, oil for my hair, comb for my beard!

I know the gifts you need to find, but only a small part of me will go with you to guide you. The sand will tell you where to look when you are there. But you will have to be thorough!

Are you ready to set out?

Great!

This is what I've learned. Each stele has a riddle and three possible answers on it. Riddles are different everywhere, but the answers are the same. Apparently, each riddle has one answer...

I have translated everything, but I don't know the correct answers. Selecting an answer is simple, you just need to touch the word. It would be dangerous to pick something at random - the Junes preferred to play it safe, there are probably safety systems in place...

Ah, there's another thing. According to my research, the nearby jinns must know something about these mysteries. But I'm not dealing with them! Terrible creatures...

What else do you want to know?

Beep, beep! Greetings, Creator.

I'm glad you're alive. It means the Savior fulfilled his promise and protected you from Sarn's Curse.

Reporting. The world is split into pieces and inhabited by many weak Curses. New aggressive life forms detected. Wind guardians detected. WARNING! There is a risk of losing the Key of Air! WARNING! It is recommended that you put me in a combat mode and send an alarm signal to the nearest Hunter temple!

A codeword is required for this.

I repeat, a codeword is required.

I repeat, a codeword is required.

Beep!

Fulfilling directive No. 5!

The artifact will be in storage until we need it. Artifact requested. Artifact given to the Creator!

Directive fulfilled. To put items back in the secret storage, use Directive No. 6!

We need to deal with this quickly...

Excellent. According to my information, no one should attack you. It should be a surprisingly peaceful task for this prophecy... Now take a good long look at Skulnar, then turn to me and nod in a pointed manner. It would look cool, if anyone is watching...
Oh, again with those trials and legends... How long is this gonna take?

Well, when the storm begins, summoning this Uro-Boros will be easy... You will run around and shout a bit - here in this suspicious hole filled with bones... And then...

My intuition tells me that it will be easier for us to... Break the worm mentally, not physically! I'm not a Psionicist for nothing. I'll have to concentrate properly for this, so... Well... You'll distract it. Any way you can. I'll try to be quick.

Well… This is probably how you became the Hero of Sarnaut. Thank you for your honesty.

Regarding our business... My investigation is going well! The pioneers turned out to be even more cunning than I thought, but I have a couple of leads... I'm not sure when I'll figure it out, but I will.

That's nice to hear... Thank you for your honesty. Hopefully I will live up to that.

By the way, my investigation is going well! The pioneers turned out to be even more cunning than I thought, but I have a couple of leads... I'm not sure when I'll figure it out, but I will.
I don't know yet... I think you need Hassan ibn Khottab. It's always safe there, and it's easy to get anywhere from that place...
How did I end up here...

Oh! Give it here.

So, let's dilute it with this... We'll pour it here... Shake it properly... And swallow quickly!

Huh? Phew... It's strong. But acts quickly. I will be able to walk in 10 seconds... But fighting and running around dungeons will only be possible in two weeks.

Do you have time? Will you accompany me to this jinn, Hassan ibn Khottab? I'll be fine on my own after that.

Oh, great! Anyway, this journey won't make us any poorer, that's for sure. Alright, my legs are falling asleep already.

We going? I need to get to Hassan ibn Khottab, then I'll figure out the rest...

...Just give me the chests first, you don't need to carry all this heavy stuff yourself.
Well, look... You are here, Skulnar is here, the guys are here... Everyone is here, and even the Unyielding have gone quiet. Which means we start now! And if someone's late - that's their problem...
We're going back to the camp. We'll officially declare Skulnar the leader and the Legendary Orc. As for you, we'll see. I'll think of something. See you near my throne, hah.

What do you think? Let's go see Fury the Merciless!

Me showing up with you should at least be puzzling for the orcs, so hopefully they won't attack right away.

Act calmly. Just keep walking and speak when spoken to.

Are we going?
I've been waiting for a while.
Ohh, wait. You're the bane of worms! It's thanks to you that my brother came back alive! Wow. Respect!

Well, damn it. I understand, there is so much going on!

Look, you can't go there alone, you'll be jumped immediately... But fine, I'll take you! Let's go?
Well, you sure don't lack for courage. The only reason we left you alone was because we already had our hands full. Tell me why you're here, or get out while you can.

Me? You're the one suggesting.

You will help us solve our problems with the Unyielding. Then the balance of power will be disrupted, and they won't be able to storm the cities when we attack.
